name: Baked salmon, broccoli and brown rice
steps: Preheat oven to 200C. Place salmon on a tray, drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the rice and steam the broccoli, then serve together.

name: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry with noodles
steps: Slice the chicken thinly and stir-fry in sesame oil over high heat until cooked through.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry a further 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Meanwhile cook the noodles, then toss through the pan with soy sauce.

name: Lean beef chilli with rice
steps: Brown the mince in a pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add diced pepper, kidney beans and chopped tomatoes, then simmer 15-20 minutes.
Cook the rice separately and serve the chilli on top.

name: Vegetable and cheese pasta bake
steps: Cook the pasta until just al dente, then drain.
Dice courgette and pepper, simmer with the chopped tomatoes for 10 minutes to make a sauce.
Mix through the pasta, top with mozzarella and grill or bake until melted and golden.

name: Fish pie with mashed sweet potato
steps: Boil the sweet potato until soft, then mash with a splash of milk.
Poach the cod gently in the remaining milk for 5-6 minutes until it flakes easily.
Flake the fish into a dish with the peas, top with mash, and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

name: Roast chicken with root vegetables
steps: Chop the carrots, parsnips and sweet potato, toss in olive oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes.
Add the chicken to the tray and roast a further 20 minutes until cooked through.
Rest briefly, then serve chicken and vegetables together.

name: Turkey meatballs with spaghetti
steps: Shape the turkey mince into small meatballs and brown in a pan on all sides.
Add diced courgette and chopped tomatoes, then simmer 15 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs and sauce spooned over.

name: Prawn and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 3-4 minutes, then add the prawns and cook until pink and opaque.
Stir through soy sauce and serve over the rice.

name: Chickpea and spinach curry with rice
steps: Simmer the chickpeas with the chopped tomatoes and a mild curry spice blend for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and cook until just wilted.
Serve over cooked brown rice.

name: Baked cod with new potatoes and green beans
steps: Boil the new potatoes until tender, about 15-18 minutes.
Place cod on a tray with a drizzle of olive oil and bake at 200C for 12-15 minutes.
Steam the green beans for the last 4-5 minutes and serve everything together.
